## Research Interests

Patient-derived organoid (PDO) models of hormone-dependent cancers — prostate and gynecologic.
Integration of whole-exome and transcriptome profiles with drug-response phenotypes to nominate
genotype-matched therapeutic vulnerabilities for preclinical precision oncology.

## Research Experience

**Graduate Researcher** — Cancer Research Institute, Seoul National University (20XX–present)

- Established and maintained patient-derived prostate and gynecologic cancer organoid lines
  from surgical and biopsy specimens; cryobanking and quality control of a model panel
- Designed and executed 96-well drug-response screens (CellTiter-Glo 3D), including plate-layout
  design, plate-wise control normalization, outlier handling, and dose–response/IC50 modeling
- Built an end-to-end analysis pipeline for model characterization: WES variant processing and
  oncoprint generation, loss-of-heterozygosity and microsatellite-instability profiling,
  SNP fingerprinting for model identity, RNA-seq clustering and ssGSEA/Hallmark scoring,
  and pathway-activity inference
- Integrated in-house models with public pharmacogenomic resources (DepMap, PRISM, GDSC2) to
  validate candidate biomarkers and define subtype-adjusted expression signatures
- Linked genotype to drug sensitivity across MAPK, DNA-damage-response, and cell-cycle axes

## Technical Skills

**Wet lab** — 3D organoid culture (establishment, passaging, cryopreservation), drug-sensitivity
assays (CellTiter-Glo 3D), DNA/RNA extraction, qPCR

**Genomics** — whole-exome variant processing and annotation, oncoprint visualization,
LOH and MSI profiling, SNP fingerprinting, BAM-level inspection

**Transcriptomics** — expression-matrix QC and clustering, ssGSEA / Hallmark enrichment,
pathway-activity inference (PROGENy), signature construction with subtype adjustment

**Pharmacogenomics** — dose–response and IC50/AUC modeling; integration with DepMap, PRISM, GDSC2

**Computing** — Python (pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn), R (tidyverse, Bioconductor), Git,
reproducible project structure with pinned dependencies

**Languages** — Korean (native), English (research proficiency)
